properties.description:
Built the same day the incident that prompted it was recorded, and from that incident rather than from a hypothesis. `fact:a-settled-question-was-re-asked-because-the-requirements-prose-outlived-its-decision` observed a settled question being put to the owner a second time because a requirement's statement still said the fork was open three weeks after the Decision closed it. This epoch carries the instrument that would have caught it: `cap:a-settled-decision-names-governed-prose-that-still-reads-open`.

FOLLOWS THE STATUS-SIDE SIBLING'S SHAPE DELIBERATELY — a block in the reply the caller is already reading, at the moment the divergence is created, rather than a detector that finds it later on a graph where the prose has already misled somebody. The choice was re-measured rather than inherited: 48 of 640 governed nodes would fire as a sweep, and a good share of those are legitimate.
properties.name: The prose-currency family grows a second member: prose that outlives the Decision governing it
